verdict.rationale: Numeral's docs cover most of the certificate lifecycle. The `certificate_request` object triggers collection from customers. The API can list and retrieve stored certificates with per-jurisdiction validity and a download URL, and the MCP server also exposes certificates. The pricing page claims automatic validation of each uploaded certificate plus expiration tracking and renewals. Nothing in the pack shows certificates being applied automatically at calculation time, which is a key part of the end-to-end story. Missing for 10: evidence that certificates are applied automatically to calculations, in-depth docs on the validation and expiry workflow (beyond pricing-page bullets), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
